Approval of Reclamation Projects. The power of the President to
approve reclamation projects is hereby delegated to the NEDA Bosrd. The PRA shall
continue to process, evaluate and recommend the approval of ail Dioposed reclamation
projects to the NEDA Board. Proposed reclamation projects endorsed by te PRA to the
NEDA Board should include all relevant documents as may be leguired by the NEDA

The NEDA Board approval shall be required:
For reclamation projects initiated/proposed by PRA or any government
entilv allowed under existing laws to reclaim land;
For reclamation projects initiated by the private sector/entity through PRA,
Local Government Units (LGUs) or other government agencies authorized
to reclaim land; and
For reclamations / reclamation components of respective development
projects of such agencies mandated to reclaim under their respective
charters such as but not limited to the following agencies: Philippine Ports
Authority (PPA). Laguna Lake Development Authority (LLDA), Bases
Conversion and Development Authority (BCDA), Subic Bay Metropolitan
Authoritv (SBMA). Philippine Veterans Investment Development
Corporation (PHIVIDEC). Department of Public Works and Highways
(DPWH), and National Power Corporation (IPC).

Powers, Functions, and Mandate of PRA. Except for the power to
approve reclamation projects, all other powers, functions, and mandates of PRA shail
be retained and exercised by PRA.

Environmental Compliance Certificate (ECC). Prior to the
implementation of reclamation projects dulv approved pursuant to Section 1 hereo, an
ECC shall be secured from the Department of Environment and Natural Resources
(DENR). No reclamation work shall commence without the required ECC.

Competitive Bidding. All reclamation projects shall undergo
competitive public bidding consistent with the government's thrust to promote
transparency and competitiveness.

Transitory Provision. In accomplishing the prescribed provisions
herein, the following transitory provisions shall be complied with:
This Order shall apply to all reclamation projects, including those initiated
by LGUs and all other government agencies/government owned or
controlled corporations including PA, LLDA, BCDA, SBMA, PHIVIDEC,
DPWH, NPC and others, for which there are no contracts/agreements yet
executed between the government entity concerned and a private sector
proponent prior to the effectivity of this Order.

Within two (2) months after the effectivity of this Order, the PRA shall
provide the NEDA Board a list of all reclamation projects approved by
PRA and relevant information, i.e., project location, date approved by
PRA, project proponents (government and private entities), total project
cost/amount, and implementation period, classified as follows:
Under actual phvsical reclamation or implementation; and
Not vet started with implementation or actual physical reclamation
but either with duly executed contracts with a private sector
proponent or are undergoing/undergone bidding or are yet to
undergo bidding.

Implementing Rules and Regulations. NDA and PRA shail issue
such rules and regulations as may be necessary to implement this Order.

Separability Clause. Should any provision of this Order be
declared invalid or unconstitutional, the other provisions unaffected thereby shall remain
valid and subsisting.

Repealing Clause. All orders, proclamations, rules, regulations, or
parts thereof, which are inconsistent with any of the provisions of this Order are hereby
repealed or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this
